name: oura-ring-mcp
description: Read-only access to your Oura Ring readiness, sleep, activity, HRV, heart rate and trends.
long_description:
Ask about your Oura Ring readiness, sleep, HRV, activity, stress and heart rate. Everything is **read-only**: the server can only send GET requests to Oura's data API.

**One-time setup**

1. Create an Oura API application at https://cloud.ouraring.com/oauth/applications with the redirect URI `http://localhost:8787/callback`.
2. In a terminal, run `npx -y @royreznik/oura-ring-mcp auth` and paste the app's Client ID and Secret. Approve access in your browser.
3. Install this extension. It reads the tokens saved in step 2 and refreshes them automatically.

Tokens stay on your computer, and data is fetched only from Oura's official API.

Full documentation: https://github.com/royreznik/oura-ring-mcp
